hero.intro: The Lux Black is a private chauffeur service for those who measure luxury in discretion. A vetted driver, an immaculate vehicle, and an itinerary that bends to you — nothing less.

services.heading: Every journey, considered in advance.
services.intro: From the gate to the gala, our service lines are built around discretion and precision.

items.title: M&A Season Corporate Transport
items.summary: Dedicated fleet and standby chauffeurs for deal teams through earnings and M&A season — discreet, billable, and on call around the clock.

items.title: Airport Transfers
items.summary: Flight-tracked arrivals and departures across EWR, JFK, LGA and TEB, with meet-and-greet at the terminal.

items.title: Executive Chauffeur Protocols
items.summary: Vetted, trained chauffeurs operating to a fixed standard of privacy, punctuality, and presentation on every assignment.

items.title: Hourly & As-Directed
items.summary: A chauffeur and vehicle at your disposal, for the hour or for the day, anywhere across the tri-state area.

fleet.heading: A garage curated, not assembled.
fleet.intro: Each vehicle is maintained to showroom condition and assigned a single, vetted chauffeur.

items.name: Mercedes-Benz E-Class
items.blurb: The everyday standard for the discerning traveler. A sleek, hushed cabin for airport runs and city meetings alike.

items.name: Mercedes-Benz S-Class
items.blurb: The flagship saloon. Reclining rear suite, immaculate finish, and a presence that needs no announcement.

items.name: Cadillac Escalade
items.blurb: Commanding stature for groups and luggage-heavy transfers. Captain seating, elevated sightlines, generous hold.

body.text: We do not sell rides. We protect time, privacy, and composure — arriving early, waiting quietly, and disappearing the moment the door closes.

closingCta.body: Reserve a chauffeur in minutes, or speak directly with our concierge desk — available at every hour.

page.title: Speak with the concierge.
page.intro: Tell us when and where. We handle the rest.
